## Albabit T2I - I2I Workflow for Radiance:

- Radiance: [Documentation](https://www.fxtdstudios.com/comfyu-radiance-docs/)
- Radiance: [GitHub](https://github.com/FXTD-Studios/radiance)

## Prompting Tips

1. **Whole scene**: Describe the framing, the subject, the background and the light, as one full caption
2. **Edit Image**: Describe only the change. FLUX 3 Klein cites the image as `<ref_image_0>`, Qwen-Image 2.1 as `<image1>`

## Radiance Report Issues :
To report any issues with Radiance nodes, [go to GitHub](https://github.com/FXTD-Studios/radiance/issues)

## Model Links (for Local Users)

Pick the family in the Loader's preset: the Sampler, in "Auto", follows it. The files go in `ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models`, `text_encoders` and `vae`. Links marked 🔒 open after accepting the license on their Hugging Face page.

nodes.title: Note: Mode
widgets_values:
**Mode** (the "Mode" node's menu):
- In every mode, the Resolution sets the output size.
- **Text to Image**: the image below is not used, but its file must exist.
- **Edit Image**: FLUX 3 Klein, FLUX.2, Qwen-Image 2.1 and Qwen-Image Edit. The Prompt sees the image; describe the change.
- A reference of another shape (portrait, square) is recomposed into the Resolution's frame: set the Resolution to its shape to keep it.
- The Prompt's "resolution" sets the size FLUX 3 Klein and Qwen-Image 2.1 read the references at (0 = their own size, 1024 = 1 MP).
- **Image to Image**: any model. The image is fitted to the Resolution (scaled, then centre-cropped), encoded, then redrawn: "image_to_image_denoise" sets how much changes. The other modes ignore it.
- An edit that comes out over-sharpened and ignores the prompt: try another seed.
- The "Mode Switches" group follows the menu: nothing to set there.

nodes.title: Note: Outputs
widgets_values:
**Outputs**:
- The EXR is the HDR master (scene-linear Rec.709, 1.0 = 203 nits); the PNG is the SDR image, as decoded.
- The Viewer shows the HDR. Bypass "SDR → HDR Universal" (Ctrl+B) to see the SDR there; the EXR then holds the SDR too.
- "Depth Map" (bypassed) adds a depth pass to the Viewer and the multi-part EXR.

nodes.title: Note: Reference 2
widgets_values:
**Reference 2** (optional: select the group, then Ctrl+B):
- Edit Image only: a second image the Prompt sees, such as a product, a garment or a look to copy.
- Read by Qwen-Image 2.1, Qwen-Image Edit, FLUX.2 and FLUX 3 Klein.
- Cite the images in the prompt: Qwen-Image 2.1 as `<image1>`, `<image2>`; FLUX 3 Klein as `<ref_image_0>`, `<ref_image_1>`.

nodes.title: Note: AI Fill
widgets_values:
**AI Fill** (optional: select the group, then Ctrl+B):
- Draws the inside of fully clipped highlights (sun, lamps, a white sky) that "SDR → HDR Universal" leaves flat, and sets their brightness (up to 3 stops above the master).
- Plausible, not recovered. The SDR view does not change: only the HDR master gains detail. With nothing clipped, it changes nothing.
- First run: downloads about 8 GB into models/radiance (RUDRA AI fill v3 and Wan2.1-VACE-1.3B). Needs about 16 GB of VRAM.
- "prompt_highlight": what to draw (e.g. "soft clouds in a bright blue sky"). Empty uses RUDRA's own prompt; a custom one loads an 11 GB text encoder once.
